title: Mean energy of a quantum harmonic oscillator
caption: From Z = e^{−ħω/2k_BT}/(1 − e^{−ħω/k_BT}): ⟨E⟩ = ħω(½ + 1/(e^{ħω/k_BT} − 1)). At low T it stays at the zero-point energy ½ħω; at high T it approaches the classical value k_BT (dashed). At k_BT = ħω it is 1.082 ħω, already within 8% of k_BT.
alt: Graph of mean energy over hbar omega against k_B T over hbar omega: a curve starting at 0.5 and joining the straight line E = k_B T at high temperature.
description: The horizontal axis is k_BT/ħω; the vertical axis is ⟨E⟩/ħω.
The solid curve is ½ + 1/(e^{ħω/k_BT} − 1): it starts at the zero-point energy ½ and rises.
The dashed line is the classical equipartition value ⟨E⟩ = k_BT; the quantum curve joins it once k_BT ≫ ħω.
